tagline: Back roads under the old Uwharries, and a forty-dollar bridge.
intro: High Pines Church Road runs about nine miles through southern Randolph County, near the Birkhead Mountains Wilderness, past hardwood forest, open pasture and outcrops of native rock, to Lassiter Mill Road. The Uwharries here are counted among the oldest mountains on the continent.

The core of the wilderness is a plantation that John Watson Birkhead pieced together from small tenant farms, and old homesteads, crumbling chimneys and the traces of gold mining can still be seen there. An extension from Ulah follows Pisgah Covered Bridge Road southwest to the bridge and on to rejoin the main road.

moments.title: Pisgah Covered Bridge
moments.text: Built in 1911 for $40, it was washed away by a flood in 2003 and rebuilt the next year from materials volunteers recovered, about 90 percent of the original.

moments.title: Robbins Branch Trail
moments.text: Two miles up Lassiter Mill Road a trailhead leads into the wilderness, where every path is a hiking trail and horses and vehicles are kept out.
